decisions.reason: The client asks to apply the same connector treatment to the sensor board; the main-board layout is the reference and remains unchanged.
The source concerns repositioning bottom connectors on the sensor board and does not change the power-board layout.
The sensor-board connector adjustment does not concern the power board's battery connector placement, spacing, or orientation.
Moving and reorienting sensor-board connectors does not alter the interboard connector types, pinouts, or power and signal topology.
The source changes mechanical placement and orientation, not the sensor connector inventory, connector types, pinouts, or count.
Sensor-board connector placement has no necessary effect on the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channels, or measurement coverage.
Repositioning connectors does not change the requirement that the SPS30 SEL pin be hardwired to ground for I2C mode.
The mechanical connector change does not alter sensor logic levels, level-shifter omission, or future adapter-board support.
The source concerns sensor-board bottom connectors, not the main-board panel power-button connector or its PWRON connection.
The sensor-board mechanical adjustment does not change standalone USB power capacity, regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
Connector repositioning does not necessarily change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-ups, or series-resistor configuration.
The mechanical relocation and orientation of sensor-board connectors does not alter the switched 5V rail's GPIO control, loads, or operating behavior.
